p.i: Stoici nullum boni genus agnoscunt, nisi solam virtutem: & quòd cæteras res necessarias & utiles ad vitam, non bona, sed commoda volunt vocari.
Et profectò si comparentur cum virtute, vix est, ut boni instar habeant.

main_text.p: Dedit autem ita dissentiendi occasionem Socra-tes in Apologia apud Platonem,cùm res alias o-mnes comparatas cum virtute pro nihilo putat, & in mortis periculo, & post hanc vitam nihil utilitatis adferre ostendit.

p.i: Quanquam si rectè ponderemus, non tam rebus, quàm verbis dissentiunt ab Academicis & Peripate-ticis.

Epicuréos autem relinquimus, ut qui in voluptate summum bonum ponant, & ita virtutes ventri & libidini subjiciant. Quanquam sunt, qui putent, eos intellexisse illam voluptatem, quam quis ex virtute capit, approbante & recreante conscientiâ, & itai-psam animi tranquillitatem significasse.

main_text.head: Cap. 8. Celeberrima apud antiquos & recentiores philosophia distributio.
main_text.p: Philosophiæ[?] partitio an-tiquissima.Omnium celeberrima philosophiæ partitio nobis videtur ea, quâ philosophia dividitur in Naturalem, Moralem, & Dialecticam, sive (res namq; eodem recidit) in Theoreticam, Practicā, & Poëticam. Naturalis enim hic latè accipitur, ita ut non solùm Physiologiam, sed etiam Metaphysicam & Mathematicas disciplinas complectatur. Et Dialectica complectitur fuso significatu artes disserendi. page.notes: The word "Quanquam" in the fourth paragraph and the one in the fifth paragraph are underlined in the print; the underline is not reproduced. Long s is read as s throughout. The note "Summum bonum apud Epicuréos." is set in roman type in the left margin and is split across several lines in the print. The initial "O" is a large woodcut initial, joined to "Omnium" as printed in the scan's first line only as "Mnium"; the opening word is "Omnium". The marginal note's first word is set as "Philosophiç", which I read as "Philosophiæ" with a ligature, so it is marked [?]. The catchword "statur" is the completion of "te-" and is printed at the right below the last line. Italic and roman type in the body are read from the scan and may be imperfect in places.
